messages:
emma.k: Quick sync — I'm putting forward a compact intake + prioritization checklist for new models we bring up. Goal: surface quality signals fast for quant experiments and set clear regression cutoffs. Thoughts?

raj.p: Love it. Can we keep the checklist < 8 items? Ops gets overwhelmed with long lists.

kai: +1, short and measurable. Also: define which prompt sets are required vs optional (:eyes:)

emma.k: Agreed. Draft below. Please flag anything missing. It's intended to be run in the eval harness as part of the first canary. If any fail, we block quant rollout.

sophia: What's the exact pass/fail rule? Absolute delta or relative? Example?

emma.k: Thinking hybrid: require no more than X% absolute drop on core quality tasks OR no more than Y% relative degradation on diversified prompts. Concrete defaults:

```
- Core QA F1: no > 2.5 points absolute drop
- Summarization ROUGE-L: no > 3.0 points absolute drop
- Toxicity rate: no increase > 0.5% absolute
- LLM hallucination test (exemplar set): no > 5% relative regression
```

nora: How do we pick X/Y per model family? Small models might need looser cutoffs.

emma.k: We scale thresholds by baseline size cohort. Proposal: map model size -> multiplier table in the intake form. I'll add to the form.

kai: Also capture latency tail and token quality tradeoffs. If quant drops quality a bit but latency improves 30% it might be acceptable with a risk flag.

raj.p: Agree. Add an explicit 'cost-latency tradeoff' checkbox and numeric tolerance field.

sophia: For prompt sets: required = core QA, summarization, instruction-following. Optional = codegen, math, domain-specific. We should version the prompt sets in the harness.

emma.k: Exactly. Required harness run sequence (automated):
1) smoke eval (sanity)
2) core-suite (required targets)
3) diversity-suite (sampling-based)
4) regression suite (previous baseline diff)

eval-bot: deploy-bot: eval harness run started for model redwood/timeslice-v2-quant @ 2076543225

nora: How long to run the diversity-suite? We can't block infra for days.

kai: Use sampling+stratified subsets — 5k examples should be enough for signal. Run full 50k offline if needed later.

sophia: Automation detail: harness should output a single summary JSON with per-suite pass/fail and numeric diffs. Then our CI can gate.

emma.k: Yep. Example summary snippet we expect:

```
{"core_suite":{"status":"FAIL","delta_f1":-3.1},"latency":{"p95_ms":210}}
```

raj.p: For the intake ranking: fields to include in the form — model_name, baseline_model, size_class, expected qps, primary use-cases, privacy concerns, preferred quant config, risk_tier.

emma.k: I'll update the intake form draft after this thread. Final ask: people reply with any fields we should add OR objections to the thresholds by EOD.

sophia: No objections from me. Add an opt-in for manual review slot.

nora: +1, include a 'quick rollback plan' field (who to page, fallback model)

kai: I'll add the stratified sampling script to the harness repo and link after PR.

emma.k: Thanks all. I'll post the updated form and a one-page checklist after changes. :thumbsup: 

eval-bot: deploy-bot: eval harness run completed for redwood/timeslice-v2-quant @ 2076543358 — Result: core_suite FAIL (delta_f1 -3.1) — blocking rollout

raj.p: OK blocking. Re-assigning to quant-owners to debug.

nora: Assigning to @kai and @sophia. Let's follow up in a separate thread for triage.
